description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. Fix the issue where the color picker slider cannot be slid in some cases.  
2. Fix the issue where file paths are incorrect in certain languages when importing files in‑game.  
3. Fix the issue where the cursor fails to automatically center after its state changes when moved via key controls.  
4. Refactor and optimize the mod loading and compressed file processing functionality within the launcher.

（若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.修复颜色选择器滑块在部分情况下无法滑动到问题
2.修复游戏内导入文件时文件路径在部分语言下错误的问题
3.修复按键控制光标移动时光标状态发生变化后无法自动居中的问题
4.重构优化启动器内的模组加载与压缩文件处理功能
